source.name: West Virginia DEP, All DEP Wells (TAGIS map service)

at_risk.definition: WVDEP status Shutin or Abandoned Well (not in the USGS count), with a responsible party named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked. All 3,789 USGS West Virginia wells match by API number; WVDEP lists 'OPERATOR UNKNOWN' as responsible party on 3,702 of them.
